title: 第17章 泥沼怪来袭第18章 解锁民俗图纸 泥沼地
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地

院子里。
沈易打量着沈坤，上手摸到他的筋肉强度确实提升了不少，不由露出笑容：
“你小子行啊！”
“嘿嘿，没大哥你厉害。”
沈坤憨笑着挠了下头，随后问道：“大哥，我以后能跟你一起出去做事了吧。”
“当然没问题。”
沈易点头笑道，随即示意竹篓里的东西。
“拿着，帮忙将这批红茄果植株和野菜种到菜地里去。”
“是！”
沈坤和沈鸢立即应下，拿起竹篓朝后院的菜地走去。
等三人忙完的时候已经快天黑了，立即回到屋内做好应对精怪袭击的准备。
今天晚上仍旧是只有灯笼鬼出没。
一晚迅速过去。
将从杨铭家得到的深乌箭也拿出来用于射杀灯笼鬼后，现在沈易手上的阴魂木已经达到了107之多！
不过目前有9支对付过雾影怪的深乌箭耐久值已经下降到仅剩10点。
只能够再用来猎杀一次灯笼鬼，过后就会彻底报废。
到时候肯定是要将这九支深乌箭升到2级的，就是不知道具体升级需要多少阴魂木。
还有其余15支深乌箭的耐久值也不多了，届时都得需要通过升级补足耐久值。
所以沈易暂时没有动用阴魂木，打算在之后将深乌箭升到2级。

……
第二天一大早。
由于水缸里的水所剩无几了，沈易叫上沈坤一起去水井打水。
刚排队打完水，村心大榕树下传来了一阵剧烈的吵闹声。
在场的人不由纷纷循声望过去。
大榕树下。
王大泉和王铁明父子俩手里正拿着大刀，脸色平静中带着杀气。
在他们面前的几人脑袋缩了缩，还是扯着嗓子喊道：
“这头妖兔本来就应该是大家平分，妖兔是小韬先发现的，也是我和小韬一起合力牵扯住的，凭什么你们两个就要拿走一半？”
“就凭老子是狩猎二队的副队长，队长不在，这里我说了算，怎么着？不服气再来跟我唠唠来。”
王铁明左手拍着大刀，一脸不屑地盯着几人。
“我跟你们说嗷，别不识好歹，要不是老子瞅准机会斩断了这妖兔的脖子，它早就跑了。”
“它的腿都被我打断了，它根本跑不了，而且小韬他也准备要拿下这头妖兔了。”
“这三天大家打到的猎物，你们父子俩都分走大半，我们也没说什么啊，还想分走大部分妖兽肉就太过分了。”
两人争执不休，声音几乎传遍了整座黑山村，引得人人都围过来看热闹。
沈易两兄弟混在人群里，也在看着这一场闹剧。
“啧，大哥，那只妖兔可真大啊，都有一头小野猪的体型了，怕不是三四十斤了吧？”
沈坤直勾勾盯着不远处地上的那只兔子。
这只兔子通体皮毛呈现灰青色，略有纹路，四肢的尖爪闪烁着寒芒，极其锐利。
它的眼睛也是青灰色的，此时眼神已经黯淡下去，显然是死了有一段时间了。

第一次看到妖兽，沈易略微感到惊奇。
他没有回话，而是将目光一转，落到王大泉六人身上。
这帮人显然都是狩猎二队的成员。
几人中只有副队长王铁明是气血境四重的修行者，听说已经有突破到五重的迹象。
其余人都只是气血境二三重。

yard.
Shen Yi looked at Shen Kun and felt that the strength of his muscles had indeed improved a lot. He couldn't help but smile:
"You kid can do it!"
"Hehe, you are not as good as big brother."
Shen Kun smiled and scratched his head, and then asked: "Brother, can I go out and do things with you in the future?"
"Of course no problem."
Shen Yi nodded and smiled, then motioned to the things in the bamboo basket.
"Take it and help plant these red tomato plants and wild vegetables into the vegetable field."
"Yes!"
Shen Kun and Shen Yuan immediately agreed, picked up the bamboo baskets and walked towards the vegetable patch in the backyard.
It was almost dark by the time the three of them finished their work, and they immediately returned to the house to prepare for the attack by the spirits.
Tonight, only the lantern ghost is still haunting.
The night passed quickly.
After using the deep black arrows obtained from Yang Ming's house to kill the lantern ghost, Shen Yi now has 107 Haunted Soul Woods in his hands!
However, the durability value of 9 Deep Black Arrows that have dealt with the fog shadow monster has dropped to only 10 points.
It can only be used to hunt Lantern Ghost once more, and then it will be completely scrapped.
At that time, these nine deep black arrows must be upgraded to level 2, but I don’t know how much Yinhun wood is needed for the specific upgrade.
The durability of the remaining 15 Deep Black Arrows is also low, and they will all need to be upgraded to make up for the durability.
Therefore, Shen Yi did not use the Haunted Soul Wood for the time being, and planned to upgrade the Deep Black Arrow to level 2 in the future.
…
Early the next morning.
Since there was not much water left in the water tank, Shen Yi asked Shen Kun to go to the well to fetch water.
Just after queuing up to get water, there was a violent noise under the big banyan tree in the center of the village.
People present couldn't help but follow the sound one after another.
Under the big banyan tree.
Wang Daquan and Wang Tieming, father and son, were holding broadswords in their hands, with murderous looks on their faces.
The few people in front of them shrank their heads, but still shouted at the top of their lungs:
"This demon rabbit should be divided equally among everyone. Xiao Tao discovered the demon rabbit first, and Xiao Tao and I worked together to get it involved. Why should you two take half of it?"
"Just because I am the deputy captain of the second hunting team, and the captain is not here, I have the final say here, so what? Come and chat with me if you are not convinced."
Wang Tieming patted the big knife with his left hand and stared at several people with disdain.
"I'm telling you, don't be ignorant. If I hadn't taken the opportunity to cut off the neck of this monster rabbit, it would have run away long ago."
"I broke its legs and it can't run away at all, and Xiao Tao is also planning to capture this monster rabbit."
"You and your son have shared most of the prey that we have caught in the past three days. We didn't say anything. It would be too much to want to share most of the monster meat."
The two argued endlessly, and the sound almost spread throughout the entire Black Mountain Village, attracting everyone to gather around to watch the excitement.
The two brothers Shen Yi were mixed in the crowd and were also watching this farce.
"Tsk, brother, that demon rabbit is really big. It's the size of a small wild boar. I'm afraid it weighs thirty or forty pounds, right?"
Shen Kun stared straight at the rabbit on the ground not far away.
The rabbit's fur was grey-green with slight lines, and the sharp claws on its limbs shone with a cold light and were extremely sharp.
Its eyes were also blue-grey. At this time, their eyes had dimmed, and it had obviously been dead for a while.
Seeing the monster for the first time, Shen Yi was slightly surprised.
He did not reply, but turned his gaze to the six Wang Daquan people.
These people were obviously members of the second hunting team.
Among them, only the deputy captain Wang Tieming is a practitioner at the fourth level of Qi and Blood Realm. It is said that there are signs of breaking through to the fifth level.
The rest of the people are only at the second or third level of Qi and Blood Realm.
